Store, show and forget API keys

Usage:
  kaab auth [command]

Available Commands:
  login       Check an API key and store it in a profile
  logout      Forget a profile and its keys
  status      Show the profiles and check the selected one's key

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for auth

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)

Use "kaab auth [command] --help" for more information about a command.
